scope: raw -> normalized -> entity mapping -> automated QA -> anomaly flag -> candidate status -> dashboard summary

status_policy.quality_passed: no failed checks and no material warning
status_policy.quality_warning: non-blocking missing fields or limited release/freshness/license details
status_policy.quality_failed: required schema or core value/date checks fail

anomaly_retention_policy: Keep raw and normalized value with anomaly_flag/review_flag; do not silently delete.
